```lean
theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : 6 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
  constructor
  · have h2 : 2 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) :=
      by apply dvd_mul_right 2; apply dvd_mul_right 2; apply dvd_refl
    exact h2
  · have h3 : 3 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) :=
      by apply dvd_mul_right 3; apply dvd_mul_right 3; apply dvd_refl
    exact h3
```
